title: Persona declaration, plugins/<persona>/persona.json (ADR-0066 Decision 2)
description: Format 1.0 holds identity, the deliverable noun, the runtime footer floor, the capabilities and the decide data; 1.1 adds verbs, each verb's profiles, default profile, request placeholder, ensemble type, phase-note artifact sections and proposal texts; 1.2 adds peer, the peer policy; 1.3 adds investigate's brief_file and output_root_env, where its brief is not named after its default profile. Cross-field rules the schema cannot state (the decide fallback equals the registry preset, profile_presets needs its map, tie_break names a fallback axis, a verb's default profile is one of its profiles, each enrolled unit's and region's fields are present, a variant region is enrolled exactly where its declared value says, the privacy spec is a file of the plugin) are checked by scripts/sync-persona-pipeline.mjs. Validated with the closed keyword subset of plugins/runtime/scripts/lib/schema-validate.mjs.

name.description: The persona name; equals the plugin directory and the plugin manifests' name. The state directory, command prefix, re-injection marker, peer-run handle and self-sensor source are derived from it.

deliverable_noun.description: The deliverable as user-facing messages name it, e.g. 'business deliverable' (V2).

runtime_footer_floor.description: The oldest runtime whose footer this persona accepts (V18).

capabilities.description: Every flag is required, so no capability reads as off by absence (ADR-0066 Decision 3).

fallback.description: The in-code fallback preset (V4); must equal the registry preset of the same id.

profile_presets.description: L4 profile -> preset id (V6); present exactly when capabilities.profile_presets is on.

tie_break.description: Axes ranked first when aggregates tie, in order (V8).

verbs.description: Format 1.1: what differs per verb, keyed by verb. A runbook region reads these values; which fields a verb's regions read is checked by the generator, not here.

peer.description: Format 1.2: the peer policy. The runbooks' privacy gate renders its scope and spec, and images selects the no-image variant regions (ADR-0066 Decision 2, DD2).

privacy_scope.description: What passes the privacy gate before web search and peer dispatch, as one phrase: 'proprietary venture concepts, ...'.

privacy_spec.description: The plugin-relative file whose Privacy Gate section the gate cites.

images.description: Whether image bytes may go to the peer. A permission, not a description of the artifacts: false keeps every dispatch text-only.

line.description: One line of text: no line break, no NUL.

profiles.description: The verb's profiles; default_profile is one of them (checked by the generator).

request_placeholder.description: What the bootstrap's original request describes, e.g. 'one-line genericized business topic'.

ensemble_type.description: The peer ensemble type, where it differs by persona.

brief_file.description: investigate only: the file the brief is saved as, where it is not the default profile's name (the generator refuses it on another verb).

output_root_env.description: investigate only: the variable that overrides where the brief is saved, where it is not <NAME>_OUTPUT_ROOT (the generator refuses it on another verb).

artifact.description: The phase note's artifact sections, one list item per line (an empty item is a blank line).

rationale_gate.description: The proposal's rationale placeholder after 'why best — '.

evidence_pointers.description: The proposal's evidence placeholder before ' — pointers only'.

next_action.description: The next action the finalize step records.

terminal_requires_convergence.description: Whether the verb's terminal write waits for a converged re-critique (ADR-0066 DD5).
